data.name: Airport Madness Evolution
data.detailed_description:
From a jungle strip to a major aviation hub. Airport Madness: Evolution is the next chapter in two decades of Airport Madness gameplay. Hidden deep in the jungle, a single dirt strip cuts through the dense canopy. Two aircraft. A few weathered buildings. And the beginning of something much bigger.

Every airport in Airport Madness: Evolution begins small. Remote. Limited. Quiet. But not for long. This is a whole new direction for the series: airports that evolve over time.

You begin with a humble airfield. One runway, long enough for a twin engine to land, no gates, and a trickle of traffic. As demand grows, the airport grows with it: more runways, taxiways, gates, and aprons, transforming into a high-pressure international hub before your eyes.

Manage traffic across five distinct locations:

  • A Caribbean island paradise

  • A Swiss Alps mountain resort

  • A dense North American big-city hub

  • A tropical jungle gateway

  • A massive Middle Eastern desert mega-hub

What's new in Airport Madness: Evolution:

  • Airports That Evolve. Watch your airfield grow from a single dirt strip into a sprawling international hub as traffic demands increase.

  • 50 All-New Aircraft. Aircraft models inspired by real-world airlines.

  • Next-Gen Scenery. A brand-new terrain generation system delivers vastly improved landscapes.

  • Richer Environments. More realistic surroundings, including improved trees and foliage.

  • New Controller Tools. Stop/Go taxi control, and "Make 360" instructions for sharper airborne sequencing.

Five airports at launch, with more on the way!

data.short_description: A fast-paced air traffic management sim where you route planes, manage runways and gates, and grow a single dirt airstrip into a sprawling international hub across five distinct locations.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS Version: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM

  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio

Recommended:

  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple GPU or dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio
